verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṁ asīsakaṁ kabandhaṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantaṁ.
verses.english: “Just now, reverend, as I was descending from Vulture’s Peak Mountain I saw a headless trunk flying through the air.

verses.pali: Tassa ure akkhīni ceva honti mukhañca.
verses.english: Its eyes and mouth were on its chest.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.
verses.english: Vultures, crows, and hawks kept chasing it, pecking and clawing

verses.pali: eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṁyeva rājagahe hāriko nāma coraghātako ahosi …pe….
verses.english: “That being used to be an executioner named Taker right here in Rājagaha. …”
